授業目的: This course aims to help students understand the basic concepts and logics in marketing management, as well as provides the information about the recent trends of the marketing study.
到達目標: Students can correctly explain the concepts, and can apply the logics and business models in the analysis of business case and data. Moreover, students shall be able to search the domestic and oversea information/data for their explanation. Finally, students can identify the marketing management concepts or methods from this course and apply these in their own research.
授業方法: While teacher unfolds each lecture, students are encouraged to actively participate in the discussion and presentation. Prior to each class, students must accomplish reading the relevant textbook chapter, material (mainly academic paper, see Reference Books). In certain occasions a presentation shall be prepared individually or in group. More details of this course will be given at the introduction.

第1回: Introduction & new realities in marketing management
About 240 minutes of self-study per session.
第2回: Fundamental considerations and planning in marketing management
第3回: Understanding the market: Analyzing consumer & business markets
第4回: Understanding the market: Conducting marketing research
第5回: Developing market strategy: Identifying market segments and target customers
第6回: Developing market strategy: Crafting a customer value proposition and positioning
第7回: Designing value: Designing and managing products
第8回: Designing value: Designing and managing services
About 240 minutes of self-study per session.
第10回: Designing value: Managing pricing and sales promotions
第12回: Communicating Value: Marketing campaign in the digital age and direct marketing
第13回: Delivering Value: Designing and managing distribution channels
